Game Overview

Starship is a fun title where navigate your spacecraft through the cosmos, deftly avoiding obstacles while collecting coins to upgrade your ship. Invest wisely in magnets and shields for strategic advantage. With responsive controls and additional lives to discover, immerse yourself in this thrilling celestial adventure and master the art of cosmic survival.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Starship is easy to pick up. Navigate your spacecraft through the cosmos, deftly avoiding obstacles while collecting coins to upgrade your ship.
